## Summary

I resolved ticket T-6007 by identifying that the docs-site 4.3 pods crash due to a security context conflict. The quarterly platform review added `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` to the security context, but Next.js needs to write to `/app/.next/cache` at startup. The fix is to add an `emptyDir` volume mounted at `/app/.next/cache` in the deployment spec, allowing the application to write its cache while maintaining the read-only root filesystem security posture.
